events.note:
Anna Pauline (Juliana)'s headstone in C2186 shows a date of birth as 1874-07-17, which differs from the date of birth in her original birth record in C2187.

In her marriage record to Georg Fengler, she is stated as being from Kolonia Pulganow, while her birth record in C2187 states that she was born in Uzowa.

Ship Name:	Californian
Years in service:	1898-1901
Funnels:	1
Masts:	3
Aliases:	Coamo (1901), Ex-State of California (1898)
Shipping Line:	Allan

Ship description:	Built by Alexander Stephen & Sons, Ltd., Glasgow, Scotland. Tonnage: 4,244. Dimensions: 386' x 46'. Single-screw, 13 knots. Triple expansion engines. Three masts and one funnel.

History:	First voyage as California, Liverpool-Portland, March 10, 1898. Stranded near Portland, February 25, 1900, later salved, sold and reconstructed as Coamo, sailing under the United States flag. Renamed: Coamo (1901). Scrapped in 1925. Ex-State of California (1898).
